# Pull Request

## Description
Please provide a clear and concise description of your changes.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New template
- [ ] Template improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number)

## Testing
Please describe how you tested your changes:
- [ ] Compiled template successfully with pdfLaTeX
- [ ] Compiled template successfully with XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX
- [ ] Tested on multiple LaTeX distributions
- [ ] Verified documentation is accurate
- [ ] Checked for spelling and grammar errors
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code/content
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

## For Template Submissions
If you're submitting a new template, please ensure:
- [ ] Template includes a comprehensive README.md
- [ ] Template compiles without errors
- [ ] Template includes example content demonstrating features
- [ ] Template uses commonly available packages
- [ ] Template includes comments explaining customization options
- [ ] Template follows LaTeX best practices

## Screenshots (if applicable)
If your changes affect the visual output, please provide screenshots or PDFs.

## Additional Notes
Any additional information that reviewers should know.
